Features of Microsoft OneDrive

Easy Storage and Access

Microsoft OneDrive provides a convenient way to store, organize, and access your files in the cloud. Upload photos, videos, and documents, and sync them across compatible devices to keep your important files available whenever you need them.

File Sharing Made Simple

Share files and folders effortlessly with friends, family, or colleagues by generating secure sharing links. OneDrive also supports collaborative editing with compatible Microsoft Office applications, allowing multiple users to work on documents together in real time.

Automatic Backup and Restore

Protect your important files with OneDrive's automatic backup and synchronization features. Keep supported files backed up in the cloud and recover them when needed. File recovery, version history, and restore options can help you recover from accidental deletions, unwanted changes, or unexpected device issues, depending on your plan.
